title: task-vector Mirror basis

random_selection.live_conflict_check: git fetch origin --prune; no remote MA-292 branch found

hypothesis: For task deltas on a fixed-radius shared two-direction orbit, two shared physical vectors plus one per-task Mirror angle preserve individual task functions and signed task arithmetic with fewer incremental bytes than native two-coefficient rank-2 SVD; unrelated deltas require private state.
physical_object: Shared pretrained linear weight vector and SVD-discovered rank-2 task-delta basis
mirror_coordinate: One angle code per task in the shared two-dimensional task-vector subspace
logical_multiplicity: Eight new task deltas represented by one physical rank-2 basis
controls: ordinary rank-2 SVD basis with two coefficients per task
rank-2 SVD with float16 task coefficients (same coefficient payload bytes as one float32 Mirror angle)
stream: Per world, four support task deltas discover the shared basis; eight new task deltas are encoded and evaluated. Aligned task deltas use a fixed-radius circular orbit in the support-discovered rank-2 subspace. Independent deltas are isotropic and unrelated. Each task is f(x)=x^T(theta0+delta) on held-out isotropic x. Also evaluate pairwise positive and negative task-vector compositions.

development.selection_metric: mean held-out per-task and signed-pair output MSE across methods and both task families; actual incremental bytes and coordinate-path throughput as preregistered tie-breakers

storage.codec: deterministic binary tensor records charging field names, method/task metadata, dtype, shape and raw bytes
paid_objects: all tensor metadata and codec headers
storage.support_vectors: not retained at inference; information retained in the paid basis

success_gate: On every fresh aligned world, Mirror per-task held-out MSE <=1.10x rank-2 FP32 SVD, pairwise signed-composition MSE <=1.10x, incremental task bytes <=0.90x FP32 SVD, and coordinate-path inference throughput >=0.5x FP32 SVD. Mirror-specific value additionally requires a better actual-byte/quality/compute frontier than the matched-byte-or-smaller FP16 SVD control.
failure_gate: Mirror misses any aligned quality/storage/runtime gate or is Pareto-dominated by the same-basis FP16 SVD control at actual serialized bytes and compute.
boundaries: Four support vectors per world discover the basis and are not evaluated task instances

amendments.change: Add rank-2 SVD with float16 task coefficients as a matched/cheaper-byte native control; select and freeze eight support task vectors.
amendments.reason: Before fresh access, code-size inspection showed two fp16 coefficients use the same raw task-code bytes as the float32 Mirror angle, while Mirror additionally stores a shared radius. Development selected eight support deltas (mean final MSE 0.034922 vs 0.036428 for four) using the registered metric.
